name: Nested cleanup failures are suppressed in occurrence order

input.source_text: let mut a = 0; let mut b = 0; class Inner { public fun next() { a = a + 1; if a < 2 { Iteration.yield(1) } else { Iteration.done } } public fun close() { raise :inner } } class Outer { public fun next() { b = b + 1; if b < 2 { Iteration.yield(1) } else { Iteration.done } } public fun close() { raise :outer } } class SI { public fun iterator() { Inner.new() } } class SO { public fun iterator() { Outer.new() } } try { for x in SO.new() { for y in SI.new() { raise :body } } } catch _, c { let s = c.suppressed; [c.value, s[0].value, s[1].value] }

applicability.reason: Pure Iris source has no native boundary.
